name: nexu-io/html-video — HTML + CSS + Data → Real MP4s; 4K Stars; 2,384 Gained This Month
hook: nexu-io's html-video converts HTML, CSS, and data into real local MP4s with 21 curated templates — no cloud rendering, no per-clip fees, no API key. Sits above Hyperframes as a pluggable render engine layer; Remotion and Motion Canvas are planned. Supports 14 coding-agent CLIs including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini. AI soundtrack via MiniMax is optional. 4,000 stars with 2,384 gained in the past 30 days — from the same nexu-io org that built open-design and html-anything.

name: nexu-io/html-anything — 7.8K Stars; Agentic HTML Editor; 75 Skills × 9 Surfaces; Zero API Key
hook: html-anything turns local Claude Code (or any of 8 supported CLIs) into an agentic HTML editor that ships production-ready single-file HTML. 75 composable skills span 9 output surfaces: keynote decks, web prototypes, Hyperframes video scripts, social cards (X, Xiaohongshu), office documents, and more. One-click export to WeChat (CSS-inlined), high-DPI PNG, standalone HTML, or Zhihu. Hard-coded anti-AI-slop constraints baked in: CJK-first fonts, 8px baseline grid, ≥4.5 contrast ratio. 7.8k stars; zero API key required since it reuses your existing CLI session.
install: git clone https://github.com/nexu-io/html-anything && cd html-anything && pnpm install && pnpm -F @html-anything/next dev

name: Graphify — ~86K Stars; Day 11; Daily Release Cadence; 71.5× Token Savings
hook: Graphify's daily release cadence continues through Day 11 — each build ships a fresh schema introspection, token-compression, or language-support improvement. 71.5× token savings on large schemas is the headline claim, and PostgreSQL live schema introspection is the anchor feature. ~86K stars as of today, with TS/JS/Swift/C++ language adapters added in recent releases.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: Claude Code v2.1.210 — Live Tool Timer; Auto Mode → Sonnet 5; Worktree Git Isolation Fix
hook: Released July 14 at 23:45 — the release sandwiched between v2.1.208/209 (covered July 14) and v2.1.211 (covered July 15), so its features have not been highlighted yet. Key changes: a live elapsed-time counter now appears on every collapsed tool summary line so long-running commands no longer look frozen; auto mode's permission classifier now defaults to Sonnet 5 instead of Opus — a direct cost and latency improvement for every auto mode user; fixed `isolation: 'worktree'` subagents that were accidentally running git commands against the main repo; and fixed the `ultracode` keyword firing on non-human-originated input (routing and webhook triggers).

hook: caveman compresses Claude Code session communication into ultra-terse 'caveman speak' — dropping articles, prepositions, and verbose phrasing while preserving technical accuracy. The result is roughly 65% fewer output tokens per session. ~88K stars on Day 7; JetBrains published an independent benchmark this week confirming the token reduction claim. Install is a one-liner skill add.

name: shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice — ~63K Stars; Day 2; 69 Actionable Tips; Input from Boris Cherny
hook: 69 battle-tested Claude Code best practices aggregated from community contributors, with cited input from Boris Cherny (Claude Code engineer). Covers CLAUDE.md structure, hook patterns, skill authoring, agent orchestration, and cost controls. ~63K stars on Day 2.

name: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents — ~21K Stars; Day 3; 100+ Specialized Subagents Across 10 Categories
hook: A curated library of 100+ specialized Claude Code subagents — each is a standalone agent with its own SYSTEM.md, tool permissions, and scope — spanning security auditors, database architects, documentation writers, and more. ~21K stars on Day 3. Install any subagent with a single `npx skills add` call.

name: Statewright — Day 3; State-Machine Engine That Blocks Disallowed Tools Per State
hook: Statewright wraps Claude Code sessions in a finite-state machine: each state declares which tools are allowed, which are blocked, and what conditions trigger transitions. Turns local models from 2/10 to 10/10 reliability by preventing the agent from using the wrong tools at the wrong time — e.g., blocking file-write tools during a 'read-only analysis' state. Day 3 in the digest.

name: shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code — ~69K Stars; Day 3; 'Bash Is All You Need'; 20-Chapter Harness Curriculum
hook: A 20-chapter learn-by-doing curriculum built around the thesis that Bash scripting is the most important skill for Claude Code power users. Each chapter ships runnable harness examples. ~69K stars on Day 3 — unusually strong retention for a curriculum repo.

name: bradautomates/claude-video — ~11K Stars; Day 6; /watch Lets Claude Watch Your Screen in Real Time
hook: claude-video gives Claude Code the ability to ingest video: feed it screen recordings, demos, or local files up to 4GB. The /watch command streams your screen to Claude in real time for live feedback. v0.2.1 added --fps and --segments flags for controlling capture granularity. ~11K stars on Day 6.
